comments.text: Two instances: api_base_controller.cr:216 and header_color_controller.cr:12 — both use read_body_safe to parse JSON. Body sizes are bounded by Athena framework's default request size limits. The UnboundedRead rule should recognize framework-provided request body readers as bounded, or at minimum not flag helper methods that wrap framework-bounded I/O.

title: FP: UnboundedRead false positive on framework-bounded request body reads
